derived_results.claim: Using only elementary half-integer Beta/Jacobi CDF formulas plus directed Decimal interval arithmetic, every interior R~Beta(31/2,3) and U~Beta(37/2,37/2) quantile center used at N=128,256,512 is certified inside a uniform +/-4e-15 bracket. No regularized-incomplete-beta evaluation is needed.

The certified probability-box half-width shrinks from 1.0000001e-8 to 4e-15, a factor 2,500,000.25. Minimum CDF slacks remain positive: N128 R 6.80e-16/U 1.04e-15; N256 R 3.68e-16/U 3.81e-16; N512 R 1.99e-16/U 3.49e-16.

Re-evaluating the fixed r95 46-rectangle engineering cover with the tighter certified boxes leaves all 46 positive and the partition unchanged (2 rectangles at N=256, 44 at N=512). Minimum lower sum increases from 0.2042649458203 to 0.2043918924040; every rectangle margin increases.

negative_or_scope_evidence: The fixed 46-cover recheck remains binary64 engineering evidence; the end-to-end outward-rounded C_mumu cell arithmetic is still pending.

The elementary quantile certificate still trusts Python Decimal semantics and a conservatively widened Decimal sqrt primitive; it removes the much larger regularized-incomplete-beta dependency but is not a proof-assistant/MPFI certificate.
All results remain restricted to the standardized frozen m=32 NIG/four-corner iid Gaussian setup and the existing analytic p_theta/p_rho<=3.817 premise.

candidate_new.mechanism: Before spending proof effort on the 46 shared rectangles, shrink probability-grid uncertainty to an elementary-certified near-machine-precision bracket. This removes special-function inverse-CDF trust from the main proof path and slightly increases every shared-rectangle lower margin without changing the deterministic partition.
candidate_new.status: all N=128/256/512 brackets certified at +/-4e-15; 46-cover outward pass remains

If those five remain outward-positive, process the remaining 41 rectangles in ascending tight-box engineering margin; split only a true interval failure.
